roll

On this page

@dice-roller/rpg-dice-roller / Roll

Class: Roll<T> ​

Defined in: src/Roll.ts:88

One evaluated notation: the result tree and its totals.

Can be used on its own, or through a Roller, which adds rolls made by roll() to its history.

total is calculated straight away; minTotal / maxTotal evaluate the expression again in min / max mode on first access, and are cached (or taken from the data on import). Each evaluation gets a fresh generated-roll budget per pool; when it is spent, repeating modifiers return the dice rolled so far instead of throwing for the limit. The readonly properties do not make the result tree or shared settings deeply immutable. Roll data is snapshotted per roll; rerolls reuse it unless replacement data is supplied.

Example ​

ts
const roll = new Roll("4d6kh3");   // rolls straight away
roll.total;                        // e.g. 14
`${roll}`;                         // e.g. "4d6kh3: [3d, 5, 6, 3] = 14"

new Roll("4d6", { engine: { name: "mersenne", seed: 42 } });

Type Parameters ​

T ​

T = string

the output type of the configured presenter

Constructors ​

Constructor ​

new Roll<T>(input, options?): Roll<T>

Defined in: src/Roll.ts:112

Parses (if a string) and rolls the input. RollData is restored as it is, without rolling or validating: its result and totals are used, and reroll() rolls its expression. Use Roll.import() / Roll.fromJSON() for exported data, which validate it.

Parameters ​

input ​

string | ExpressionNode | RollData

the notation or expression to roll, or data to restore without validation

options? ​

RollSettings<T> | RollOptions<T>

how to roll; RollSettings are used as they are, so they can be shared

Returns ​

Roll<T>

the notation is invalid

Accessors ​

averageTotal ​

Get Signature ​

get averageTotal(): number

Defined in: src/Roll.ts:210

The expression evaluated with each pool's quantity times its die's average. Uses the stored die snapshots without rolling again or rounding intermediate averages.

Rolls containing modifiers or conditionals retain the midpoint of minTotal and maxTotal. Conditional mode totals are not guaranteed bounds and their midpoint is not a statistical mean (see #293). This is not a statistical mean for modifiers, non-linear maths or random die parameters. Its uncached extrema use fresh per-pool budgets and include any partial results when exhausted.

maxTotal ​

Get Signature ​

get maxTotal(): number

Defined in: src/Roll.ts:196

Total with each die at its maximum, rounded to 2 decimal places; not necessarily an expression maximum (e.g. -d6). Modifier-generated rolls stop at the fresh per-pool budget.

Returns ​

number

minTotal ​

Get Signature ​

get minTotal(): number

Defined in: src/Roll.ts:191

Total with each die at its minimum, rounded to 2 decimal places; not necessarily an expression minimum (e.g. -d6). Modifier-generated rolls stop at the fresh per-pool budget.

number

Defined in: src/Roll.ts:153

Creates a roll from exported data (e.g. from toJSON()), without rolling.

The options are used by reroll(). Pools refer to their die by factory name, so re-rolling uses the die registered under that name in these settings.
